incentives.fixture_category: Linear / Area / High Bay (all interior fixture types)
incentives.measure_type: LED Retrofit or New Fixture (Express Path)
incentives.equipment_requirements: DLC or ENERGY STAR listed LED; new system must use less energy than existing/baseline
incentives.baseline_description: Existing non-LED interior fixture (fluorescent, HID, etc.)
incentives.replacement_description: DLC or ENERGY STAR LED interior fixture or retrofit kit
incentives.notes: Express path; post-purchase application; excludes replacement lamps, controls-only, new construction, and LED-baseline projects

incentives.fixture_category: Linear / Area / High Bay (all interior fixture types)
incentives.measure_type: LED Retrofit with Networked Lighting Controls
incentives.equipment_requirements: DLC or ENERGY STAR LED with qualified networked lighting controls (NLC) or ANLC
incentives.replacement_description: DLC or ENERGY STAR LED with networked lighting control module
incentives.notes: Higher incentive tier for networked/advanced networked controls; plug-and-play controls-ready fixtures may qualify

incentives.measure_type: LED Retrofit or New Fixture (Express Path)
incentives.equipment_requirements: DLC or ENERGY STAR listed LED exterior fixture; dusk-to-dawn operation by default
incentives.baseline_description: Existing non-LED exterior fixture (HPS, MH, fluorescent)
incentives.replacement_description: DLC or ENERGY STAR LED exterior fixture
incentives.notes: Express path has different (lower) rate for exterior vs. interior; parking garages = interior; top decks = exterior

incentives.equipment_requirements: Retrofit only; variable load must be present; throttling/bypass devices must be removed or permanently disabled; not required by IECC
incentives.baseline_description: Constant-speed HVAC fan or pump motor
incentives.replacement_description: VFD-controlled HVAC fan or pump motor
incentives.notes: $65/HP for typical upgrade path; new construction VFDs not eligible for prescriptive rate

incentives.equipment_requirements: ENERGY STAR® certified ground- or groundwater-source heat pump
incentives.notes: Base incentive $62/ton; additional $125/ton available for newly installed qualifying systems per HVAC application

incentives.equipment_requirements: Efficiency must exceed IECC/AHRI baseline; IPLV rated per AHRI 550/590; chiller loads ≤20% process; VFD on compressor accounted for in IPLV
incentives.replacement_description: High-efficiency chiller exceeding program efficiency thresholds
incentives.notes: Custom/calculated path; energy savings subject to Rocky Mountain Power approval

incentives.equipment_requirements: Retrofit only; <1 HP or 1–10 HP HVAC application ECM
incentives.baseline_description: Shaded-pole or PSC motor in HVAC application
incentives.replacement_description: Electronically Commutated Motor (ECM) in HVAC application
incentives.notes: $200/HP for HVAC applications up to 10 HP; refrigeration ECM applications use $/watt rate instead

incentives.equipment_requirements: LED must be listed on qualified products list; replacing fluorescent lamp in refrigerated cases
incentives.baseline_description: Fluorescent lamp in refrigerated display case
incentives.replacement_description: Qualified LED in refrigerated display case
incentives.notes: Listed on Wyoming Incentive List under refrigeration category; exact $/unit rate requires PDF review

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Interior LED Retrofit – No Controls (Express)
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: DLC or ENERGY STAR LED fixture or retrofit kit
prescriptive_measures.notes: Express path; post-purchase application; incentive is per watt of LED installed, not per watt reduced; excludes LED-baseline projects

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Interior LED High Bay Retrofit – No Controls (Express)
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: DLC LED high bay fixture
prescriptive_measures.notes: Express path; all interior fixture types share the same per-watt-installed rate; wattages are representative estimates

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Interior LED Retrofit – Networked Lighting Controls (Express)
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: DLC LED fixture with networked lighting control module
prescriptive_measures.notes: Higher rate for networked/advanced networked controls; plug-and-play controls-ready fixtures eligible if module installed

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Exterior LED Area/Parking Retrofit – No Controls (Express)
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: DLC LED exterior area fixture
prescriptive_measures.notes: Lower rate for exterior vs. interior; dusk-to-dawn operation assumed by default; top parking decks = exterior

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Small & Medium Business Express (SMBE) – Interior LED
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: DLC or ENERGY STAR LED interior fixture
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: Up to 75% of total project materials and installation paid directly to vendor
prescriptive_measures.notes: SMBE path for verified small/medium business customers; incentive paid directly to vendor as invoice credit; customer co-pay as low as 25%

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: LED Sign – Channel Letters or Marquee/Cabinet
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Fluorescent tubes in marquee/cabinet sign or neon channel letters
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: LED illuminant in channel letters or LED tubes in cabinet/marquee sign
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: $/linear foot of LED illuminant (channel letters: measured linear footage of LED; cabinet: linear footage of fluorescent tubes replaced)
prescriptive_measures.notes: Exact $/linear-foot rate requires PDF review; measurement methodology differs by sign type

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: VFD for HVAC Fan or Pump – Retrofit
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Constant-speed HVAC fan or pump motor
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: VFD-controlled HVAC fan or pump motor
prescriptive_measures.notes: Throttling/bypass devices must be removed; variable load must be present; IECC-required VFDs not eligible; new construction excluded from prescriptive rate

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Ground/Groundwater-Source Heat Pump – ENERGY STAR
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Conventional air-source or electric resistance HVAC system
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: ENERGY STAR certified ground- or groundwater-source heat pump
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: $62/ton × system tons (e.g., 5 tons × $62 = $310); additional $125/ton available for newly installed qualifying systems
prescriptive_measures.notes: Base $62/ton for ENERGY STAR qualified; additional $125/ton for newly installed systems; incentive paid per ton of cooling capacity

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Advanced Rooftop Unit Controller (ARC) – Existing RTU
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Existing unitary package rooftop unit (1–15 years old, no split-systems) without advanced controls
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Advanced rooftop controller with supply fan VFD or multi-speed fan, CO2/occupancy sensor, and integrated economizer
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: Incentive per RTU varies by tonnage of unit controlled; see HVAC application table
prescriptive_measures.notes: RTU must be 1–15 years old; units >15 years require pre-approval; must include VFD or multi-speed fan, CO2/occupancy sensor, and digital economizer; three incentive options offered per RTU (only one may be claimed)

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: High-Efficiency Chiller
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: High-efficiency chiller exceeding AHRI 550/590 efficiency thresholds
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: $0.15/kWh × annual kWh savings (calculated by Rocky Mountain Power)
prescriptive_measures.notes: Calculated/custom path; chiller loads must be ≤20% process-related; no non-standard operational practices; VFD on compressor must be reflected in IPLV rating; energy savings subject to Rocky Mountain Power approval

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Zone Controller / Occupancy-Based HVAC Controller
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Uncontrolled or timer-based HVAC zone system
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Occupancy-based zone controller with temperature setback capability for unoccupied periods
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: Flat per-unit incentive; exact amount requires PDF review
prescriptive_measures.notes: Controller must include occupancy-based control and temperature setback during unoccupied periods and setup once occupied; exact dollar rate requires PDF

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Electronically Commutated Motor (ECM) – HVAC Application (<1 HP and 1–10 HP)
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Shaded-pole or PSC motor in HVAC application
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Electronically Commutated Motor (ECM) in HVAC application
prescriptive_measures.notes: Retrofit only; HVAC application ECMs <1 HP and 1–10 HP eligible at $200/HP; refrigeration application ECMs use $/watt rate; Green Motor Rewinds removed from program effective Oct 2025

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Electronically Commutated Motor (ECM) – Refrigeration Application (<1 HP)
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Electronically Commutated Motor (ECM) in refrigeration application
prescriptive_measures.notes: Retrofit only; refrigeration application ECMs <1 HP use $3/watt rate; HVAC applications use $200/HP rate instead

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: LED Retrofit in Refrigerated Display Cases
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Fluorescent lamp in refrigerated display case
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Qualified LED in refrigerated display case
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: Flat per-unit incentive; exact amount requires PDF review
prescriptive_measures.notes: LED must be listed on qualified products list; exact $/unit rate requires PDF review of Wyoming Incentive Lists document

prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Integrated Demand-Side Energy Control (IDEC)
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Standard HVAC system without demand-side energy controls
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: IDEC system meeting program efficiency requirements
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: $0.15/kWh × annual kWh savings (calculated by Rocky Mountain Power)
prescriptive_measures.notes: IDEC energy savings subject to Rocky Mountain Power approval; $0.15/kWh annual savings rate confirmed in Wyoming Incentive Lists PDF
